Method of Attack: Hiding malware within image files using steganography
Impacted Systems: PyPI users through open-source projects on Github
Attack Vector: The package downloads an image hosted on Imgur and uses the newly installed package, called judyb, to process the picture and trigger the processing generated output using the exec command.

Method of Attack: Steganography module, responsible for hiding and revealing hidden messages inside pictures
Impacted Systems: PyPI users through open-source projects on Github
Attack Vector: Used to extract obfuscated Python code hidden in the image, once decoded it retrieves and executes a malicious binary from a remote server.
